boundaries: Cheeger-Gromov compactness itself is stated, not proved: the three manifold statements are def ... : Prop with explicit hypotheses/conclusions and no proof body.
The pinned mathlib revision has no Riemannian distance, exponential map, injectivity radius or curvature tensor; dist, injRadius and the curvature tensors are explicit interface data.
The stated conclusion is pointed C^1 (smooth version: every C^k); the classical C^{1,alpha} conclusion is not claimed.

The discrete model is a finite class by hypothesis (fixed label count, fixed finite value set, uniform two-sided bounds); it is the finite epsilon-net/pigeonhole content, not a discrete-to-continuous limit theorem.
Related mathlib context, not connected here: Mathlib/Topology/MetricSpace/GromovHausdorff.lean (GHSpace, ghDist, GromovHausdorff.totallyBounded for compact metric spaces).
Nothing here proves Ricci-flow existence, Perelman monotonicity, kappa-noncollapsing, canonical neighbourhoods, surgery, extinction or the Poincare conjecture.
